name: Watching Television
overview: Scripture calls believers to guard their eyes against wickedness and to focus on what is pure, honest, and praiseworthy, as emphasized in Psalms 101:3 and Philippians 4:8. The importance of training oneself and children in godly ways is highlighted in Proverbs 22:6, ensuring that one's habits align with a life drawn to Christ, who draws all men to Himself (John 12:32). Recognizing that all have sinned (Romans 3:23), faith grows through hearing the Word of God (Romans 10:17), which should shape our choices, including how we engage with media such as television.
